All 7 tasks complete. Here's what was built:

**Files created (3,303 lines total):**

| File | Lines | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `index.html` | 12 | Loads Three.js CDN + all scripts in order |
| `person.js` | 153 | Person mesh factory with walk/sit limb animation |
| `world.js` | 993 | 6-floor building, furniture, nav graph, call panels, BFS pathfinding |
| `elevator_logic.js` | 335 | Pure elevator state machine (SCAN scheduling, 4-rider capacity, door timing) |
| `elevator.js` | 246 | Three.js car geometry, sliding doors, destination panel, wraps ElevatorLogic |
| `sim.js` | 1,297 | Clock, day/night, 20 workers + 80 visitors, plan compilers, collision, HUD |
| `elevator_logic_test.js` | 267 | 7 deterministic Node tests (all passing) |

**Key behaviors implemented:**
- Workers arrive 8:15-9:30, sit at desks, attend meetings, break at lounge, lunch at cafe, depart 5-7 PM with stragglers
- Visitors cycle continuously via top-up scheduler, weighted activities (cafe, lounges, pit, meetings, loitering)
- Elevator uses SCAN scheduling with passenger destination priority, anti-starvation guards, and 12s door safety cap
- Entrance has a real 3-unit wall gap with `outside -> front_door_threshold -> entrance -> lobby_center` nav chain
- Collision avoidance with boarder exemption, stall recovery, jittered spawns, and zero-overlap handling
